shortDefinition.en: The extent of the scene recorded by the camera, determined by the optical setup, recording dimensions, and geometry.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 相机记录场景的范围，由光学配置、记录尺寸和几何条件共同决定。

en: Field of view and perspective are not interchangeable terms.
zh-cn: 视角与透视不是可以互换的概念。

example.en: A smaller sensor records a narrower view with the same lens and camera position.
example.zh-cn: 同一镜头和机位下，较小传感器记录更窄的视角。

sources.title: The DX and FX Formats — Nikon
sources.supports: The effect of format and lens choice on the recorded view.
